title: Hotpath sampling and compact quantile-sketch aggregator for interactive console routes
creator: Ayesha Kaur
description:
Goal: produce a compact, tenant-aware nearline summary of 'hot' interactive console requests (short lived sessions / UI-driven routes) that captures latency distributions, p50/p95/p99 sketches and lightweight categorical counts. This will enable fast SLO attribution dashboards, anomaly detection, and cost-latency correlation without scanning raw callstream tables.

Proposed approach: instrument backend gateway to emit a 'hot-sample' event for the top N requests per tenant per minute (deterministic hash + rate cap). A nearline job consumes events and maintains per-tenant per-route compact sketches (KLL or t-digest) and limited recent histograms. Store results in a curated table optimized for point lookups by tenant+route+hour with a compact binary sketch payload and human-readable aggregates (p50/p95/p99). Expose a light materialized view for Grafana panels and the Console API.

Constraints/requirements: must add <5% additional storage to analytics cluster, support incremental updates, tolerate eventual consistency (nearline window <= 3 minutes), and allow fallback to full raw query for deep investigation. Design should consider multi-region tenants and encryption-at-rest for sketches.

Trade-offs considered: KLL vs TDigest (KLL offers smaller worst-case error for quantiles and simpler merge semantics for per-shard aggregation; TDigest better for extreme tails). We favour KLL for this workload but will prototype both on sample traffic. Sampling policy will be deterministic to maintain stability across replays and reduce bias at low volumes.

Deliverables: schema PR, ingestion consumer, enrichment job, curated table DDL, Autoschema docs, Grafana panels and a Console route to surface quick-look metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Schema and DDL reviewed and merged
Nearline consumer runs with end-to-end test harness and sample data
Sketch merge correctness validated vs raw histograms on historical window (error < 3% at p95/p99 for top 90% tenants)
Query: point lookup for tenant+route+hour returns aggregated p50/p95/p99 and sketch in <200ms for cold cache
Grafana dashboard panels for SLO slices (p50/p95/p99) are populated from the curated table
Data retention policy documented and storage costs estimated (<5% growth)
Security review completed for telemetry and sketch payloads
